text:
karen: quick sync on SDK retry builder for paginated endpoints. We've had multiple tiny variants across SDKs and it's time to standardize. Key goals: respect server recommended window, allow user override, and keep default behavior safe for browser environments.

leo: propose a RetryPolicy shape: { maxAttempts, baseMs, maxMs, jitter, maxTotalMs } where maxTotalMs defaults to recommended_retry_window*1000 if present. SDK constructor merges serverHints with user options.

mike: ergonomics: in JS browser we should cap maxAttempts to 3 and disable aggressive jittering to conserve battery. Node and py can be more aggressive.

nora: tests: e2e with flaky network that drops connections; ensure paginated iterator resumes only within window and surface CursorExpired beyond that. Also add an interop test between node and py to ensure both respect maxTotalMs.

ops-bot: queued job retry-policy-standardization PR build
